actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Environment and Public Works.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 361 - 56 (Roll no. 29). (text: CR H449)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 361 - 56 (Roll no. 29). (text: CR H449)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H451-452)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 776.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H449-450)
Mr. Westerman moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Affects state agencies receiving federal financial assistance to eradicate or control nutria and restore damaged marshlands.
dimensions.evidence: allows the Department of the Interior to provide financial assistance to states for (1) eradicating or controlling nutria, and (2) restoring marshland

dimensions.assessment: Extends an existing invasive species control and habitat restoration program without altering its fundamental rules.
dimensions.evidence: Section 3(e) of the Nutria Eradication and Control Act of 2003... is amended by striking '2025' and inserting '2030'.

dimensions.assessment: Continues eligibility for federal financial assistance funding authorizations for nutria management through 2030.
Performs a simple statutory sunset extension and a technical correction.
dimensions.evidence: Section 3(e) of the Nutria Eradication and Control Act of 2003 (16 U.S.C. 8102(e)) is amended by striking '2025' and inserting '2030'.

dimensions.assessment: Extends the program authorization for a fixed period of five years through fiscal year 2030.
dimensions.evidence: is amended by striking '2025' and inserting '2030'

importance_detail.rationale: The bill extends the authorization of appropriations for the Nutria Eradication and Control Act of 2003 through fiscal year 2030.
